name: Soto de Cerrato (Spain)
description: A red hoist third bearing two white Maltese crosses and a yellow crown, the fly yellow charged with the crowned municipal arms of Soto de Cerrato (trees on red within a bordure of crosses).
history: Municipal flag of Soto de Cerrato; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: two Maltese crosses above and below the crown
